title: The prescribed trace counit is the coordinate evaluation
statement:
Canonical section variables and instances are those of the attached Lean module.

theorem ordinaryFiniteTraceCounit_coordinate_evaluation
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y)
    (τ : (ordinaryFinitePushforward A f).obj ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj L) ⟶
      ordinaryFiniteUnit A Y) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    (ordinaryFiniteTraceCounit A f ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj L) τ).app K =
      CoordinateTrace.evaluation A f L (τ ≫ (ordinaryFiniteSingleUnitIso A Y).hom) K

source.place: Supported diagonal kernel, section projection contractions, and counit base change

proof.text: Precompose with the invertible ordered projection. Its defining counit equation identifies the left side with tensor of the scalar trace followed by the single-object unit comparison and right unitor. The inverse ordered projection in coordinate evaluation cancels. Identify the cached unit comparison by its defining equation and apply tensor functoriality and category associativity.
